import html # The HTML template that contains a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Submission

Your Content:

{user_content}
""" def create_html_output(input_text: str) -> str: """ Create an HTML page by inserting the provided user content into a predefined template. The function escapes the user input to prevent injection attacks and ensure that the resulting page remains well‑formed. Args: input_text: The raw text supplied by a user. Returns: A string containing the complete HTML page with the escaped content. """ # Escape special HTML characters to avoid breaking the markup safe_content = html.escape(input_text, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
